products.title: Metric Male Flat Seat Hose Fitting
products.focusKeyword: metric male flat seat hose fitting
products.descriptionShort: Metric Male Flat Seat — flat face with an O-ring, seating against a flat mating face, in 13 sizes from -04.
products.descriptionLong:
The Metric Male Flat Seat Hose Fitting is a hydraulic hose fitting with flat face with an O-ring, seating against a flat mating face.

The O-ring does the sealing, not the thread — a flat-seat joint tightens against a face, so it does not need the cone angle a 60° or 74° port depends on.

Construction

  • Configuration: straight
  • Thread: M14×1.5 to M64×2
  • Sealing form: Flat face with an O-ring, seating against a flat mating face
  • Gender: male
  • Material: carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated (316 stainless on request)

Sizes

13 sizes, hose bore -04 to -32, threads M14×1.5 to M64×2. The full size and dimension table is on this page.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number for the size you need. Tell us the hose grade and bore and we will include the matching crimp ferrule — the ferrule follows the hose, not the fitting. Indus crimps and pressure-tests assemblies before dispatch.
products.seoTitle: Metric Male Flat Seat Hose Fitting | M14×1.5–M64×2
products.seoDescription: Metric Male Flat Seat Hose Fitting — 13 sizes (-04 to -32), M14×1.5 to M64×2. Carbon steel or 316 stainless, ex-Dubai.

faqs.question: What is the sealing form?
faqs.answer: Flat face with an O-ring, seating against a flat mating face. Pair it with the matching counterpart — a mismatched sealing form will seat but will not hold pressure.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: 13 sizes, hose bore -04 to -32, threads M14×1.5 to M64×2. Every combination in the table on this page is an orderable part number.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The hose grade and bore set the assembly rating, not the fitting. A correctly crimped fitting does not derate the hose. Tell us the grade and bore on the RFQ and we will confirm the figure in writing.

faqs.question: Which ferrule pairs with this fitting?
faqs.answer: The one that matches your hose grade — the skive/no-skive choice follows the hose construction, not the fitting end. Send the hose grade with your enquiry and we will specify the ferrule and the crimp diameter.

faqs.question: Is stainless steel available?
faqs.answer: Yes — 316 stainless on request across the range. Standard supply is carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated. Add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Can Indus crimp the assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. We crimp, pressure-test and certify assemblies in Dubai and ship UAE-wide. Send the hose grade, bore, both end fittings, overall length and orientation.

90° is the included angle — 45° per side, the same seat geometry as an SAE 45° flare, on a metric thread. It will not mate with a 60° or a 74° port.

Construction

  • Configuration: straight
  • Thread: M12×1 to M22×1.5
  • Sealing form: 90° included cone (45° per side), metal-to-metal
  • Gender: male
  • Material: carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated (316 stainless on request)

Sizes

9 sizes, hose bore -04 to -08, threads M12×1 to M22×1.5. The full size and dimension table is on this page.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number for the size you need. Tell us the hose grade and bore and we will include the matching crimp ferrule — the ferrule follows the hose, not the fitting. Indus crimps and pressure-tests assemblies before dispatch.
